text.what: One of France's smallest regions — about 1,950 hectares — where pinot noir shares the cellar with poulsard and trousseau and sometimes ends up in the white blend.
text.how: Continental and colder than Burgundy, especially in winter. Pinot noir is permitted in Arbois and Côtes du Jura, alone or blended.

kin.as: One of three reds allowed, and rarely the loudest.
Sixty miles west, and the comparison every Jura grower fields.
